name: Easy PDF Reader for All Cloud

ios.desc:
Easy PDF Reader is a complete solution to view your PDF documents on a large display like TV. With its super intuitive interface, viewing PDFs is fun.

Easy PDF Reader supports multiple cloud services you can access files from Google Drive, Dropbox, or Microsoft OneDrive right away (no need to import) and not just that it also allows you to directly share PDFs from your Mac/ PC using WiFi over local network.

PDF viewer screen is smartly designed to keep it super fast and user-friendly, some of the great features include zoom up to 2x, preview pane for a quick view, easy file access, thumbnail previews and much more.

Get Easy PDF now and start using it the way you want, be it in office meetings, class presentations and or anywhere it fits your need.
